rootCauses: The final scene used CONVEX_HULL for the open-tumbler mesh while the accepted calibration used CYLINDER; the collision proxy was not exact-match.
Initial containment was checked only at frame 1, allowing visible leakage before the derived contact frame.
The 0.07 m source plus surface reconstruction exceeded the 0.09 m inner radius at frame 1.
decision: Retain attempt-07 as FAIL. F4 may use the exact calibrated CYLINDER collision shape, reduce the liquid source without weakening the 5 percent threshold, and require every pre-contact frame to pass containment.
